Title: Verify that OTP generation for worker activation enforces rate limiting to prevent abuse
Section: Worker Management - OTP Generation and Verification
Preconditions: A shop owner is authenticated and has a valid shop ID. A worker record exists with a valid email and phone number.
Steps:
1. Send 10 consecutive POST requests to /api/shops/{shopId}/workers/sendOtp with the payload in testData within 1 second. 2. Observe the response for each request.

Test Data: {"email": "worker@example.com", "phone": "+1234567890", "role": "CUTTING_MASTER"}
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 201 (Created) for the first few requests, then starts responding with HTTP status 429 (Too Many Requests) and a response body containing 'status: error', 'message: Too many requests'.

Title: Verify that OTP verification for worker activation rejects expired OTPs

Steps:

Test Data: {"phone": "+1234567890", "pin": "1234", "otp": "OLD_OTP"}
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 (Bad Request) and a response body containing 'status: error', 'message: OTP has expired'. The worker's PIN is not set.
